get.description: Read-only local projection of one durable original capital command. Strict id/workspace query, current exact TS-accepted audit.read before disclosure and after final I/O, including all DENY and delegation ancestry. The original sender may differ from this reviewer; original send expiry does not revoke current report permission. Immutable command/profile/qualification/intent/status correlation is checked. Four outcome dimensions remain separate; UNKNOWN never causes resend. source_as_of_ms is null because no owning-source cutoff is stored; observed_at_ms is the Portal local-read clock, not source freshness. Stable snapshot_ref contains only authorized public fields and excludes private authority and read time. No prepare/send/lookup/recover/reconcile or command/event/audit writes; existing authority-provider resolution remains possible. Retained exact Core workspace is preserved. Hidden/missing share404, visible corrupt data has sanitized503. All responses are private, no-store.
